answer: Before an identity may answer, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to the epoch seed and its own key, taking about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 740 fakes pays 493 CPU-minutes every epoch plus power, while one honest agent pays once, so cloning stops scaling. The sable test is the live device, the grove test is the locked stake, and the river test is the graded history no template can fake.
